title: No Travel Incomplete | Uncontrollable | APPR
description:
Two-leg journey, Leg 2 cancelled due to security (POLI (Political events � government restrictions)). Customer stranded at midpoint (YYZ). Validates No Travel Incomplete + Uncontrollable = Not Eligible. This is the most complex No Travel + Uncontrollable combination since the customer is at neither endpoint.
